items.titleOriginal: Anthropic 更新 Claude Fable 5 生物安全防护，误报率大幅降低
items.summaryOriginal: Anthropic 更新了 Claude Fable 5 的生物安全防护机制，将生物相关查询的"回退"次数减少约 85%，用户在日常健康与教育问题上将更少遇到系统切换至较弱模型的情况。此次更新扩大了模型可协助的生物任务范围，但涉及双重用途的病毒学、毒理学和分子设计请求仍会回退至 Opus 5。Anthropic 表示正通过可信访问途径，致力于缩小专业生物研究与药物开发领域的差距。

items.importanceReasonZh: 该信息来自 OpenAI 总裁 Greg Brockman 的官方发布，涉及 ChatGPT 语音体验的重大架构升级，对语音交互领域有重要影响。
items.importanceReasonEn: The information comes from an official announcement by OpenAI president Greg Brockman, involving a major architectural upgrade to ChatGPT's voice experience, with significant impact on voice interaction.
items.titleEn: GPT-Live Real-Time Audio New Architecture Released
items.summaryZh: GPT-Live 是一种用于实时音频的新架构和栈：GPT-Live 可以在说话的同时聆听。为了让这种体验在 ChatGPT 规模下显得自然，我们从客户端到模型重建了语音栈。这一新架构让音频持续流动，因此更深入的推理和工具使用不会打断对话。
items.summaryEn: GPT-Live is a new architecture and stack for real-time audio: GPT-Live can listen while speaking. To make this experience feel natural at ChatGPT scale, we rebuilt the voice stack from client to model. This new architecture keeps audio flowing continuously, so deeper reasoning and tool use do not interrupt the conversation.
items.detailZh: GPT-Live 是 OpenAI 发布的一种用于实时音频的新架构和栈。其核心特点是能够在说话的同时聆听，实现更自然的对话体验。为了实现这一目标，OpenAI 从客户端到模型全面重建了语音栈，使得音频能够持续流动，从而在进行更深入的推理或使用工具时不会打断对话。这一架构升级旨在让 ChatGPT 的语音交互更加流畅和自然。
keyPointsZh: GPT-Live 支持边说边听，实现实时音频交互。
OpenAI 从客户端到模型重建了语音栈。
新架构使音频持续流动，推理和工具使用不打断对话。
该发布来自 OpenAI 总裁 Greg Brockman 的官方消息。
items.impactZh: 对于开发者而言，GPT-Live 可能提供新的 API 或集成方式，用于构建更自然的语音应用。对于用户，ChatGPT 的语音交互将更加流畅，减少等待时间。对于行业，这一架构可能推动实时语音 AI 的发展，提升语音助手的体验标准。

items.summaryOriginal: Release: datasette 1.0a38 This release fixes a SQL injection security issue that affects Datasette instances that serve a mixture of public and private tables in the same database, with access configured using the Datasette permissions system . Site administrators who serve private tables in this way are advised to disable the execute-sql permission ` on that database to prevent users from accessing private tables using raw SQL queries. The bug that has been fixed would have allowed users with access to any public table to execute SQL injection attacks despite that restriction, giving them read-only access to data in private tables in the same database. This fix is also available in Datasette 0.65.3 . Thankfully this particular configuration - private tables and public tables exposed for the same database within the same instance - is likely to be rare. I've not encountered an instance like that myself. Tags: security , sql-injection , datasette

items.summaryOriginal: Simon Willison on Technical Blogging I was interviewed by Cynthia Dunlop for her "Write that blog!" series back in January, but I just realized I never linked to the interview from my own blog! It includes my answers to the following questions: Why did you start blogging – and why do you continue? What has been the most surprising impact of blogging for you? What blog post are you most proud of and why? What post was the most difficult to write and how did you tackle it? Any lessons learned that you want to share with the community? Your advice for people just getting started with blogging? A few blogs that you particularly enjoy? I'll repeat my most important piece of advice here: My number one tip for blogging is to lower your standards! Aim to hit publish while you are still actively unhappy with what you have written, because the only alternative is a huge folder full of drafts and never publishing anything at all. Nobody will ever know how perfect the thing you intended to write would have been. The flaws you see in your writing are invisible to everyone else. Tags: blogging , interviews

items.summaryEn: Simon Willison shares his blogging insights in an interview with Cynthia Dunlop, covering why he started blogging, what keeps him going, his proudest post, the hardest post to write, advice for beginners, and blogs he enjoys. His top tip is to 'lower your standards' and publish while still unhappy with the piece, as perfectionism leads to a pile of drafts and readers never see the flaws you perceive.
items.detailZh:
Simon Willison 在 2026 年 1 月接受了 Cynthia Dunlop 的“写博客！”系列访谈，但直到 8 月才在自己的博客上发布链接。访谈涵盖了他写博客的动机、持续写作的原因、最自豪的文章、最难写的文章及应对方法、给社区的建议、给新手的建议以及他喜欢的几个博客。

他反复强调的最重要建议是“降低标准”：在仍然对文章不满意时就点击发布，因为唯一的选择是让草稿堆积如山，永远不发布任何东西。他指出，你眼中的瑕疵对读者来说是不可见的，完美主义是写作的敌人。

读者看不到作者眼中的瑕疵。
items.impactZh: 对于技术写作者和内容创作者，这一建议有助于克服完美主义，提高发布频率，从而建立个人品牌和知识分享。它鼓励实践而非追求完美，对社区内容生态有积极影响。

items.titleEn: Agent Plugins 1.0.0 Released: Unified Agent Plugin Spec Backed by Google, Amazon, Microsoft
items.summaryZh: Agent Plugins 1.0.0 是一项由谷歌、亚马逊、微软等支持的中立目录规范，将 Agent Skills 和 MCP 服务器打包为单一可移植单元。通过标准化 plugin.json 清单和固定目录布局，开发者无需为不同 AI 编码智能体和 IDE 维护单独封装。谷歌已作为核心维护者加入，并在 Agents CLI 和 Data Agent Kit 中提供支持。
items.summaryEn: Agent Plugins 1.0.0 is a neutral directory specification backed by Google, Amazon, Microsoft, etc., packaging Agent Skills and MCP servers into a single portable unit. With a standardized plugin.json manifest and fixed directory layout, developers no longer need to maintain separate wrappers for different AI coding agents and IDEs. Google has joined as a core maintainer and provides support in Agents CLI and Data Agent Kit.
items.detailZh: Agent Plugins 1.0.0 是一项由谷歌、亚马逊、微软等支持的中立目录规范，旨在统一 AI 编码智能体和 IDE 的插件格式。该规范将 Agent Skills 和 MCP 服务器打包为单一可移植单元，通过标准化的 plugin.json 清单和固定的目录布局，使开发者无需为不同工具维护单独的封装。谷歌已作为核心维护者加入，并在其 Agents CLI 和 Data Agent Kit 中提供了支持。
keyPointsZh: Agent Plugins 1.0.0 由谷歌、亚马逊、微软等支持，作为中立目录规范发布。
该规范将 Agent Skills 和 MCP 服务器打包为单一可移植单元。
通过标准化 plugin.json 清单和固定目录布局，简化了跨工具兼容性。
谷歌已作为核心维护者加入，并在 Agents CLI 和 Data Agent Kit 中提供支持。
items.impactZh: 对于开发者而言，该规范有望减少为不同 AI 编码智能体（如 Copilot、Codex 等）维护插件的工作量，提升插件生态的互操作性。对于行业而言，可能推动形成统一的插件标准，促进工具链的整合。

items.titleOriginal: Claude Code is the fastest agent framework but costs nearly three times more than the cheapest rival
items.summaryOriginal: Composio tested Deepseek V4 Flash across four agent frameworks on 30 real-world tasks. Success rates were mostly similar, but costs varied by nearly 3x: OpenCode came in cheapest at $0.073 per task, while Claude Code cost $0.195 despite using the fewest tool calls and output tokens. The choice of framework is mainly a question of price and speed. The article Claude Code is the fastest agent framework but costs nearly three times more than the cheapest rival appeared first on The Decoder .

items.titleZh: Claude Code 是最快的智能体框架，但成本比最便宜的竞争对手高出近三倍
items.titleEn: Claude Code is the fastest agent framework but costs nearly three times more than the cheapest rival
items.summaryZh: Composio 在 30 个真实世界任务上测试了 Deepseek V4 Flash 在四个智能体框架中的表现。成功率大致相似，但成本差异接近 3 倍：OpenCode 最便宜，每个任务 0.073 美元，而 Claude Code 每个任务 0.195 美元，尽管其工具调用和输出 token 最少。框架的选择主要取决于价格和速度。
items.summaryEn: Composio tested Deepseek V4 Flash across four agent frameworks on 30 real-world tasks. Success rates were mostly similar, but costs varied by nearly 3x: OpenCode came in cheapest at $0.073 per task, while Claude Code cost $0.195 despite using the fewest tool calls and output tokens. The choice of framework is mainly a question of price and speed.
items.detailZh:
根据 Composio 的测试，他们在 30 个真实世界任务上评估了四个智能体框架（包括 Claude Code、OpenCode 等）使用 Deepseek V4 Flash 模型的表现。结果显示，各框架的成功率大致相当，但成本差异显著。OpenCode 每个任务成本最低，为 0.073 美元，而 Claude Code 每个任务成本为 0.195 美元，是最便宜选项的近三倍。有趣的是，Claude Code 使用的工具调用次数和输出 token 数量最少，但成本仍然最高，这可能与其定价策略或内部开销有关。

该测试表明，在选择智能体框架时，除了功能外，价格和速度也是重要考量因素。对于成本敏感的项目，OpenCode 可能是更经济的选择，而 Claude Code 则可能适合对速度有更高要求的场景。
keyPointsZh: Composio 在 30 个真实任务上测试了四个智能体框架，使用 Deepseek V4 Flash 模型。
各框架成功率相似，但成本差异接近 3 倍。
OpenCode 最便宜，每任务 0.073 美元；Claude Code 最贵，每任务 0.195 美元。
Claude Code 工具调用和输出 token 最少，但成本最高。
框架选择主要取决于价格和速度需求。
items.impactZh: 对于开发者和企业，该测试结果提示在选择智能体框架时，应综合考虑成本与性能。如果预算有限，OpenCode 可能更具吸引力；如果追求速度，Claude Code 可能值得额外投入。此外，该测试也强调了评估真实任务成本的重要性，而不仅仅是模型价格。
